nodes.description: Constant state variable MAX_UINT = 2**256 - 1 returned by totalSupply, balanceOf and allowance.
Public token name string, written in the NotCoin constructor.
Public token symbol string, written in the NotCoin constructor.
Public uint8 decimals value, written in the NotCoin constructor.
Constructor NotCoin(string _name, string _symbol, uint8 _decimals): assigns name, symbol and decimals.
totalSupply(): returns the constant MAX_UINT instead of any real supply.
balanceOf(address _owner): returns MAX_UINT for every queried address.
transfer(address _to, uint _value): emits Transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value) and returns true without moving any balance.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): emits Approval(msg.sender, _spender, _value) and returns true without storing an allowance.
allowance(address _owner, address _spender): returns MAX_UINT for any owner/spender pair.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): emits Transfer and returns true with no authorization or allowance check.
msg.sender, the untrusted caller address used as the origin of Transfer/Approval events.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _name is written into the state variable name.
Constructor parameter _symbol is written into the state variable symbol.
Constructor parameter _decimals is written into the state variable decimals.
NotCoin constructor writes the name state variable.
NotCoin constructor writes the symbol state variable.
NotCoin constructor writes the decimals state variable.
totalSupply returns the constant MAX_UINT.
balanceOf returns the constant MAX_UINT.
allowance returns the constant MAX_UINT.
MAX_UINT is assigned to the balance return local variable.
balanceOf consumes its _owner parameter (ignored, MAX_UINT returned).
balanceOf returns the local variable balance.
transfer emits its _to parameter in the Transfer event.
transfer emits its _value parameter in the Transfer event.
msg.sender is forwarded into the Transfer event as the 'from' address.
approve emits its _spender parameter in the Approval event.
approve emits its _value parameter in the Approval event.
msg.sender is forwarded into the Approval event as the owner address.
allowance consumes its _owner parameter (ignored, MAX_UINT returned).
allowance consumes its _spender parameter (ignored, MAX_UINT returned).
transferFrom emits its _from parameter in the Transfer event.
transferFrom emits its _to parameter in the Transfer event.
transferFrom emits its _value parameter in the Transfer event.
transferFrom never verifies msg.sender authorization or allowance, so any caller can invoke it and emit arbitrary Transfer events.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _name only exists to initialize the name state variable inside NotCoin.
Constructor parameter _symbol only exists to initialize the symbol state variable inside NotCoin.
Constructor parameter _decimals only exists to initialize the decimals state variable inside NotCoin.
Parameter _owner is the sole input of balanceOf and does not influence its constant result.
Local return variable balance is produced and returned entirely inside balanceOf.
Parameter _to is only used as the recipient argument of the Transfer event in transfer.
Parameter _value is only used as the amount argument of the Transfer event in transfer.
Parameter _spender is only used as the spender argument of the Approval event in approve.
Parameter _value is only used as the value argument of the Approval event in approve.
Parameter _owner is the sole owner input of allowance and is ignored.
Parameter _spender is the sole spender input of allowance and is ignored.
Parameter _from is only used as the sender argument of the Transfer event in transferFrom.
Parameter _to is only used as the recipient argument of the Transfer event in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is only used as the amount argument of the Transfer event in transferFrom.
